comment: setActionBar call sites with no realm:actionbar request in their function or a helper (file -> function names; "(anonymous)" is never accepted, so name the function). hud_bp hudLoop and stats_bp tickerLoop: the Coordinates HUD and the stats ticker are the lowest steady lines, which only listen and wait (by design, but their redraw could announce a rank too); stats_bp clearTicker and hud_bp clearOnChange clear the bar with an empty string, only once another pack's note has run out. stash_bp (top level): the default hook that main.js replaces. Remove a line with its fix.
